svg.text: Real slice of the chart α + γ = 1 in Sym²(C) ≅ P²; x = α − γ and y = β.
Intrinsic relative form: D⁻¹B has eigenvalues 1, −1/2, −1/2; trace = 0.
Together with torus invariance this selects B and forces ρ + ρ⁻¹ = −4.
The real picture illustrates two algebraic conics; the proofs concern an algebraically closed field of characteristic zero.
